title: Rugby league points with bonuses
description: Feature request for the league table function of a rugby league. It receives the list of played matches and a team name and returns the league points of that team over all matches in which it played, as home team or as away team. A match has the home team, the away team, the points scored by each side and the number of tries scored by each side. Today the function gives 4 points for a win, 2 for a draw and 0 for a defeat. Add the two bonus points of rugby: (1) a try bonus: 1 extra point for a team that scored 4 or more tries in a match, whatever the result; (2) a losing bonus: 1 extra point for a team that lost the match by 7 points or fewer. A team can earn both bonuses in one match. A team that appears in no match is an error with the message "unknown team" (team names are case sensitive); this also covers an empty list of matches. A team never plays against itself.
notes: Feature: two bonuses on top of the base points, applied for the home side and the away side separately. Boundaries tested: exactly 4 tries / 3 tries, losing by exactly 7 / 8, a draw with the try bonus, a win with the try bonus, the loser of a 0-0 style match, and unknown teams including case differences. Start has the base points only. Visible examples are chosen so that the start passes them (no bonus applies).
